RecorderManager.start(Object object)

To start recording, the user must grant the microphone permission to the current Mini Program and the host app is allowed to use the system microphone(Minimum version: 23.9.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
duration Number 60000 No Recording duration, in ms. The maximum value is 180000 (3 minutes). If the user does not stop recording after the specified duration, the recording will be automatically stopped.
numberOfChannels Number 2 No Maximum number of recording channels. A larger number of recording channels indicates a higher recording quality and a larger file size.
sampleRate Number 8000 No Sampling rate, in Hz. A higher sampling rate indicates a higher recording quality and a larger file size.The simulator does not support the setting of the sampling rate.
encodeBitRate Number 480000 No Encoding bit rate, in bit/s. A higher encoding bit rate indicates higher recording quality and file size.The simulator does not support the setting of the encoding bit rate.

numberOfChannels Valid value

Valid Value Description
1 1 channel
2 2 channels

Limitations on the sampling rate and encoding bit rate

Each sampling rate has a valid encoding bit rate range. If an invalid sampling rate or encoding bit rate is set, recording fails. The following table lists the mapping between the sampling rate and encoding bit rate.

sampleRate & encodeBitRate Valid value

Valid Sampling Rate Valid Encoding Bit Rate
8000 16000 - 48000
11025 16000 - 48000
12000 24000 - 64000
16000 24000 - 96000
22050 32000 - 128000
24000 32000 - 128000
32000 48000 - 192000
44100 64000 - 320000
48000 64000 - 320000

Tips

  1. The format of the recording file is fixed as AAC. The recording file is named (yyyyMMddHHmmss.aac) after the recording start time. The recording file is saved in the local temporary directory.
  2. The start interface can be invoked only when the recording is idle. The start interface cannot be invoked when the recording is being performed or when the recording is paused.
  3. The start operation is performed on the recording manager. The operation result is obtained from the recording manager, which is different from the callback mode of common interfaces. The recorder starts recording normally. You can use RecorderManager.onStart(listener) to monitor the recording. If an error occurs, you can use RecorderManager.onError(listener) to monitor the recording.

Sample Code

<button bindtap="recorderStart" type="primary">recorderStart</button>

Page({
    recorderStart() {
        const { duration, numberOfChannels, sampleRate, encodeBitRate } = this.data;
        const params = { duration, numberOfChannels, sampleRate, encodeBitRate };
        console.log({ startParams: params });
        recorderManager.start(params);
    }
})
